decision.label: mixed / no single dominant mechanism
decision.rule: A or B requires the same category to exceed 0.5 with Wilson 95% CI lower bound > 0.5 in both 2- and 3-distractor main-analysis cohorts; otherwise C.

definitions.downstream_failure: task failure after contacting Can; critical chunk contains first Can contact
definitions.main_analysis: task failure and never contacted Can
definitions.obstruction_primary: minimum XY polyline-to-distractor-circle clearance using chunk-start positions and robosuite horizontal_radius; obstructed iff <= 0 m
definitions.success_calibration: task success; critical chunk contains first Can contact
definitions.target_intent_primary: 3D start distance to Can minus minimum 3D waypoint distance; target-directed iff > 0 m
